title: SBC Medical Group discloses theft of data on 1.6 million customers in Japan
geo_basis: Customers are of clinics in Japan; no city stated
summary: SBC Medical Group Holdings told the SEC that on 16 November 2026 an unauthorized third party accessed and extracted customer information from databases of its Japanese subsidiary. The company reports basic personal data on 1,624,000 customers, and separate access to clinic administrator accounts on the Tribeau booking service. The intrusion method and full scope remain under investigation.
plain: A Japanese clinic group says someone broke into its customer databases and took details of about 1.6 million people, including names, contact details and passwords.
exec: Large patient-facing data theft with passwords exposed; the company has not yet estimated financial impact.
action: If you are an SBC clinic customer in Japan, change any reused password and watch for phishing that uses your name or contact details.
impact: 1,624,000 customers; about 20,000 employee account records; 12,641 people on Tribeau reservation data

validation.note: Company filing with the SEC (primary) and BleepingComputer. No actor named; company has not confirmed theft of electronic medical records.

review.note: Compared 16 Nov access, 1,624,000 customers, 20,000 employee records, 12,641 Tribeau reservation people, admin accounts, no actor, no EMR confirmed against SEC 8-K Ex 99.1 and BleepingComputer
